widgets.widgetName: Name(s) as shown on your California tax return
California Secretary of State (S O S) file number (12 digits)
Part II, Line 1. Total qualified employment compensation expenditures. Enter the total amounts from Worksheet I, line 1, column (k)
Line 10a. Credit claimed. Enter the amount of the credit claimed on the current year tax return. (Do not include any assigned credit claimed on form F T B 3544, Part B.)
Line 10b. Total credit assigned. Enter the total amount from form F T B 3544, Part A, column (g). If you are not a corporation, enter 0
Line 10c. Credit amount to be elected as refundable in future years. See instructions
Line 11. Credit carryover available for future years. Add lines 10a, 10b, and 10c, subtract the result from line 9
Line 2. Safety-related equipment, training, and services expenditures
Line 3. Workforce development and employee safety training expenditures
Line 4. Total qualified expenditures. Add line 1 through line 3
Line 5. Multiply line 4 by 25%
Line 6. Credit amount. Enter the smaller of line 5 or $250,000
Line 7. Pass-through credit from Schedule K-1 (100S, 541, 565, or 568)
Line 8. Credit carryover from prior year(s)
Line 9. Total available credit. Add line 6 through line 8
Part I, Line A. Business name as it appears on the license issued by the California Department of Cannabis Control (D C C)
Line B. License type (check only one box)
Line C. License number
Line D. Did the business obtain a tentative credit reservation (T C R) from the Franchise Tax Board?
Line E. T C R confirmation number
